title: ️ParrySystem
description: Parry mechanic for skill based PvP
body:

ParrySystem is a combat plugin focused on skill-based gameplay, introducing a reaction-timed Parry mechanic inspired by games like Dark Souls and Sekiro.

By right-clicking with a Sword, Axe, Shield, Trident, or Mace at the exact moment an attack lands, players can block incoming damage and instantly counter their opponents.

There are several features in ParrySystem, such as projectile reflection, VFX and SFX through a Resource Pack, as well as a fully adjustable and flexible configuration to fit your needs.
